html:
The Soul Set consists of the best equipment in the game at the time of its release (Summer Update 2020), having a minimum level requirement of 400. The set consists of 2 pieces of equipment and weapons (one and two handed) for each vocation, including all main slots with the exception of helmets.

The attributes of these items were decided with the help of the community through a Feedback Form and a later Dev Note on New Best-in-Slot Weapons.

The items can be obtained as a one-time reward of the Soul War Quest as well as from its bosses and related creatures through the Goshnar's Taints system.
